newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING unit reports strong mortgage business.
newsitem.headline: ING unit reports strong mortgage business.

text.p: Nationale-Nederlanden, the insurance arm of financial firm Internationale Nederlanden Groep (ING), said on Thursday its mortgage loans portfolio has surpassed the level of 20 billion guilders this month.
"In less than four years, this portfolio has grown by about 35 percent," the unit said in a statement.

It added that the demand for guilder-denominated mortgage loans surged by almost 40 percent in the first 10 months of 1996 due to low interest rate levels and the growing popularity of owning houses. Nationale-Nederlanden granted 50 percent more in mortgage loans than in the same period of 1995, it said.
